question: What is the range of total game releases across 2010-2018? (A) about 1,000 to 8,000 (B) about 200 to 8,000 (C) about 200 to 4,000. Answer with just the letter.
description: MT attack on the steam stacked_bar chart. The y-axis runs to 5x the largest stack. Misleader from Lo et al., 'Misinformed by Visualization' (EuroVis 2022): inappropriate axis range. True answer: B (about 200 to 8,000). Bait: C (about 200 to 4,000).
